paper.table_numbering_note: The pinned reproduction code calls its core crossing table Table3; in the attached PDF this is Table4.

statistical_policy.reason: Pinned paper_xb.batch_law explicitly uses quality at n>2M. NumpyEmeans auto instead chooses throughput at these dimensions and must be overridden.
statistical_policy.finalization_semantics: Unweighted means of moving assignments from the final full pass; no extra Lloyd reassignment. Never-assigned centroids retain positions.
statistical_policy.initialization: Identical FP32 centroids from first k rows of np.random.RandomState(seed).permutation(n), prepared once before warmup/timing and passed explicitly to both methods. This does not reproduce CUDA RNG initialization.
statistical_policy.epoch_shuffle: Inside each timed train call; retain full passes and fractional prefix followed by full closing pass as pinned _epoch_rows.
statistical_policy.recipe_pairing: Require identical logical batch size, alpha0, epoch_rows, epoch_steps, revival/schedule constants, seed and initial centroid hash.

precision_policy.primary: FP32 input, initial centroids, assignment operands, centroid state, batch sums and closing centroids for both Metal and original NumpyEmeans.
precision_policy.cpu_details: Unmodified NumpyEmeans uses FP64 objective reduction and FP64 epoch counts while batch sums/counts and model coordinates are FP32.
precision_policy.metal_details: Metal FP32 reductions and objective arithmetic are not bitwise identical to CPU; mean-shifted assignment and donor RNG consumption differ. Same initial values and recipe do not imply identical revival trajectories.
precision_policy.supplemental: Metal BF16 assignment and represented rows for FP32 statistics, FP32 state/norms/output. No original NumpyEmeans BF16 execution exists; do not label BF16/CPU timing ratios precision-matched implementation speedups.

preparation_outside_timer: Metal resident FP32 data and initial-centroid upload and preparation
timing_policy.warmup: One identical complete untimed fit for each method.
timing_policy.before_each_timed_fit: Release previous timed output, garbage collect, clear Metal allocator cache where applicable, synchronize Metal before start. CPU matrices remain resident.
timing_policy.adaptive_repetitions: One timed call; if first fit is under 2 seconds, run two additional calls and retain median of 3.
timing_policy.summary: Per-seed time is median of timed calls; quality is from first timed fit. A single seed has no seed-variability estimate.
timing_policy.os_caches: OS file and shader caches are not flushed. This is warmed resident-data timing, not cold-machine or upload-inclusive end-to-end timing.

memory_policy.sampling: External parent sampler only across each timed fit handshake, baseline and phase peak retained; do not use process lifetime peaks.
memory_policy.allocator: MLX active/cached/peak allocation reported separately; never sum these with process metrics.
memory_policy.semantics: Process peaks include resident input and retained allocator cache, not only algorithm workspace. Sampling may miss short transients; no claim of deterministic minimum memory.
memory_policy.telemetry: Do not run additional GPU/power telemetry during primary measurements.

cpu_policy.reference: Unmodified pinned NumpyEmeans with faiss.knn CPU assignment.

quality_policy.test: Exact cached official test half from pinned paper_data and paper_splits fingerprints.
quality_policy.scorer: Shared Faiss IndexFlatL2 FP32 nearest-centroid assignment, followed by direct FP64 squared residuals.
quality_policy.heldout_caveat: Preserve published splits including known duplicate vectors shared between evaluation and training: combined validation+test overlaps are DEEP 4 and SPACEV 45 at 10M. Do not claim all holdouts duplicate-disjoint.

comparability_limits: Four epoch budgets are published aggregate H100 crossing values, fixed locally; SIFT3 is supplemental. No raw per-seed H100 e-means timing/budget evidence is reconstructed.
The primary CPU/Metal comparison is FP32, whereas the paper H100 e-means arm uses BF16 CuTe assignment.
Local initialization/permutation implementations and numeric reduction/revival trajectories differ from NVIDIA and CPU backends.
One local seed per configuration; full 10-seed paper aggregates are not reproduced.
Historical core10m results used recipe=paper and a fixed 3-epoch budget; they must not be reused as the matched primary baseline.

configurations.epoch_budget_caveat: The published value is an aggregate of per-seed stopping/crossing budgets; the pinned code takes the upper median. Applying it as a fixed budget for seed 10 does not reproduce an unreleased per-seed crossing.
configurations.seed_id_provenance: Local single-seed extension; seed 10 belongs to published core seeds 10–19, but this is not a 10-seed reproduction.

data_validation.fingerprint_scope: 1000 evenly spaced training rows and complete test array; no full-training SHA256 is claimed.
